sentence: This project studies how physical and chemical cues are combined to guide cell migration in fruit flies.
This project builds a robotic imaging system that watches the same roundworm animals throughout their lifespan.
This project tests software that uses artificial intelligence to help decide where each patient could receive care in hospitals.
This project builds a freely available software platform that unifies tools for analyzing spectroscopic data.
This project tries to find out why Parkinson’s disease decreases movement speed and also causes tremor, using models and robotic-based tasks.
This project measures how curvature changes the stiffness of two-dimensional materials placed on top of nanoscale resonators.
This project studies how organisms and their genes respond to a changing climate.
This project studies how information about predators reaches the offspring of threespined stickleback fathers.
This project creates soft materials whose structure can be actively controlled by adding chemical fuels.
This project builds tools that use artificial intelligence to study vibrational sound that travels through plant stems and leaves.
This project searches for light dark-sector particles using neutrino experiments, machine learning and quantum sensors.
This project studies proteins that bind nitrate and engineers them into sensors that can detect nitrate in living cells.
This project studies how drones, self-driving vehicles and robotic systems can work safely using artificial intelligence and machine learning.
This project studies why some populations of the purple coneflower go extinct and others persist in remnant prairies.
This project builds a tool that uses artificial intelligence to select cancer treatments tailored to each individual patient.
This project builds online lessons that teach researchers to use computing tools to study viruses and their genes.
This project builds a sensing platform that watches movement and health without recording identifiable images or understandable speech.
